race.comment: TOSEN FURY (3) was a winner at Tumut over this distance two back then tackled a longer trip last time but failed to measure up at Gundagai. Expected to bounce back. QUEUE JUMPER (2) should be hitting his straps third-up and will relish stretching to 1200m. Bold showing anticipated. GETTIN' TIPSY (8) was comfortably accounted for when 11th last time out over 1600m at Wagga, beaten 12 lengths. That followed a win at Harden at the previous outing. Has the talent to find the winners' list. WALLABY JACK (1) turned in another moderate effort last start when 6 lengths from the winner in 11th over 1300m at Wangaratta at the second run back from a spell. Well placed to make amends. FLEETLY (5) returns and looks right up to this on her best efforts. Loy's booking also adds confidence that she can run well fresh.
